seo.homeDescription: Custom apparel, bags, drinkware, corporate gifts and event essentials sourced, designed and delivered in Singapore.

hero.headline: Your one-stop sourcing solution.
hero.supportingCopy: No more chasing suppliers, designers or printers. MySOS sources, customises and delivers apparel, bags, drinkware and corporate gifts — so you can get back to running your event, team or business.

processIntro.heading: From idea to doorstep, without the runaround.
processIntro.body: A clear four-step process built around your needs, budget and deadline.

process.title: Consultation
process.body: Tell us what you need, your budget and timeline. We recommend the best route.

process.title: Fulfilment
process.body: We source from trusted factories, support the design and oversee production.

process.title: Quality check
process.body: Every item is hand-counted and inspected before it leaves us.

process.title: Delivery
process.body: We consolidate shipments and deliver around your schedule.
